items.title: Dark Horse
items.synopsis: Follows Jair Messias Bolsonaro, a man driven by his political career after disappointment with the direction of his country, in the journey to become the 38th president of Brazil.

items.title: Little Genes
items.synopsis: In 1987, on a weekend camping trip in Utah's beautiful Wasatch Mountains, fourteen-year-old Arlo Murphy is eager to prove he can be a world explorer scout like his Dad, while his parents grapple with Arlo's gender identity.

items.title: Infection
items.synopsis: An ambitious office worker suspects her boss’s mysterious illness may be contagious. With a promotion within reach, she faces a choice between professional advancement and the person she wants to remain.

items.title: Kashti Paar
items.synopsis: A silent folk-horror parable from the Indian coast. When a fight for a place on a fishing boat turns to blood, young Shreyas loses the man who raised him and is left alone on a sea that remembers every death. In the mist, a girl with a lantern is waiting.

items.title: Edo²
items.synopsis: With another summer drawing to a close in a province of Northern Italy, Edoardo fights to regain control of a youth that feels far too small for him. When an online site appears to truly get him, offering a way to fill his emptiness, Edo seizes the chance to break free from the suffocating fear of never being enough.

items.title: Baddies USA: Chapter 3
items.synopsis: The next chapter of Baddies USA continues with new music, new faces, and a whole lot of new drama.

items.title: Motu Patlu & the Mystery of Nagmani
items.original_title: Motu Patlu & the Mystery of Nagmani
items.synopsis: Motu and Patlu chase John into a time portal after he steals a precious diamond locket, sending them 900 years into the past into the ancient city of Andherius.

items.title: blood & soil
items.synopsis: A young man attends a rally.

items.title: Doozie's Doghouse
items.synopsis: Doozie is pinching into her very own Doghouse for some puppy-riffic adventures with her best pup Puggie and all her Doozie Dogs. From the creators of DreamWorks Animation's hit series Gabby's Dollhouse, Doozie's Doghouse is a mixed-media companion series that continues the fun with tail-wagging surprises, woof-tastic unboxings, and imaginative play. Creativity is limitless in Doozie's Doghouse!

items.title: One of a Kind Romance
items.synopsis: A romance driven by personal desire that unfolds when top actor Tak Mu-i and idol Ryu Min enter the ordinary daily life of job seeker Gong Yu-il.

items.title: Get Huge: Looksmaxxing to Death
items.synopsis: An unflinching portrait of masculinity in the influencer age, where extreme biohacking, online performance and a series of suspicious deaths converge.

items.title: Big Bargain Holiday Showdown
items.synopsis: Follows teams of friends, family and neighbors competing to transform a room in their home into a holiday wonderland in 48 hours on a $500 budget, judged for a chance to win cash prizes.

items.title: History's Mystery Files
items.synopsis: History has spent decades investigating the mysteries that challenge what we know about the past, and what we think is possible. HISTORY'S MYSTERY FILES revisits the most unforgettable cases, from sacred discoveries and bizarre weapons to unsolved disappearances and high strangeness. Hosted by Jorge Garcia, each episode follows the clues, the evidence and the questions that refuse to go away.

items.title: Ebenezer
items.synopsis: An elderly miser embarks on a supernatural journey after visits from the ghost of his former business partner and the Spirits of Christmas Past, Present, and Yet to Come force him to confront his past and fight for a second chance at happiness.

items.title: How to Rob a Bank
items.synopsis: A crew of social media-savvy bank robbers broadcasts their daring heists, unaware that their growing viral fame has put them in the crosshairs of a veteran FBI agent and a brilliant software engineer. Despite the unlikely duo closing in, the crime ring pushes past their limits, putting everything on the line for their most ambitious heist yet.

items.title: Victorian Psycho
items.synopsis: When eccentric young governess Winifred Notty arrives at a remote Gothic manor, a string of unsettling events leads the household to suspect she isn't who she claims to be—but the truth may be far more dangerous than they imagine.

items.title: Madden
items.synopsis: Chronicles John Madden's incredible journey alongside best friend and true original Al Davis—from a Super Bowl-winning partnership with the Raiders, to becoming football’s most recognizable voice, to building the worldwide Madden NFL video game.

items.title: Confession
items.synopsis: In 1938, in Stalin's Moscow, a disillusioned professor, Alexei, faces brutal interrogation by his former student, Vladimir, in Lubyanka Prison. Refusing to confess, he confronts his past sins and finds redemption through faith, sacrificing himself to save others in a haunting tale of morality and resistance.

items.title: The Body
items.synopsis: After a dance-team initiation gone wrong, a group of badly behaved Catholic school girls begin having prophetic visions that set off mass hysteria in their town.

items.title: Alicia's Law
items.synopsis: After her husband, a Supreme Court Justice Minister, is imprisoned for corruption, Alicia must restart her law career to support her children and pay bills as her world crumbles.

items.title: Blind Game
items.synopsis: A suspended police officer tracks down a missing fortune and a dangerous secret.

items.title: What a Boss Wants
items.synopsis: A struggling CEO's only hope to turn his career around lies in an indie singer – but neither of them expected to fall for each other.

items.title: Happy Anding
items.synopsis:
It contains the story of three unknown comedians who are running towards their dreams and a woman whose life has collapsed, getting back up and finding her dream.

Kang Tae Gu is someone who only knows extreme gags. Tae Gu was once a super rookie in the gag world and is the leader of the team Asura, which is full of passion for gags.

items.title: Under Fire
items.synopsis: As a fire captain in Idaho, Rob has spent his life saving others. Now, with the help of an experimental therapy, he may just learn how to save himself.

A heist takes 12 months to plan, 12 hours to execute—and a thief not caught within 12 days won't be caught at all. Across three pulse-pounding timelines, an FBI agent and a career criminal face off in a deadly game of cat and mouse through Europe.

items.title: The Good Daughter
items.synopsis: Sisters Charlotte and Samantha Quinn have spent the last twenty-eight years trying to piece together the lives that were fractured by a single night of violence. When another attack splinters the small town of Pikeville, Charlotte is the first witness on the scene. Now a lawyer like her father, she’s forced to confront her own demons as the case twists through one shocking revelation after another. In the end, both she and Samantha find themselves wondering if the price of being the good daughter was worth it after all.

items.title: The Secret Lives of Mormon Wives: Orange County
items.original_title: The Secret Lives of Mormon Wives: Orange County
items.synopsis: A new group of dynamic young mothers in Orange County collide in a community where beliefs are not just their religion; they are their identity. While some defend their way of life, fighting against modernity, others embrace change, becoming a platform to disrupt the status quo. Scandals and secrets will be revealed, facades will crumble, and families and friendships will change forever on both sides of the battlefield as this group of strong, game-changing influencers comes together to build their answer to #MomTok.

items.title: Crown of Deceit: Inside the Miss Universe Scandal
items.original_title: Crown of Deceit: Inside the Miss Universe Scandal
items.synopsis: Follows former Miss USA and Miss Universe contestants, insiders and whistleblowers exposing misconduct rigging and NDAs behind the pageant, including a contestant walkout and judge resignation at the 2025 Miss Universe finals in Thailand.

items.title: Never Surrender
items.synopsis: An ex-soldier and his grandchildren battle against ruthless criminals in a remote village. To survive, they must also confront their fears and regrets.

items.title: Cunk on Cinema
items.synopsis: Philomena Cunk asks experts all of the hard-hitting questions about the history of cinema, from the invention of the camera, to the New Wave filmmakers of the 60s, right up to the entrance of CGI and what the future of AI holds. Cunk will attempt to demystify it all while sitting in lumpy seats with stale popcorn, asking herself where did cinema come from? And why? What does it want? And why can't it tell us?

items.title: Miracles of the ER
items.synopsis: A bold decision brings an average med student to an elite ER team, where he encounters medical crises, ethical dilemmas, and personal growth.

items.title: Paper Tiger
items.synopsis: Two brothers become entangled in a scheme that turns out to be too good to be true. As they try to navigate their way through the dangerous world of the Russian mafia, family bonds begin to fray with life-altering consequences.

items.title: Five Figurines
items.synopsis: Five Figurines is a Nigerian feature film directed by Akay Mason that will be released in cinemas nationwide on November 13, 2026.

items.title: Far-Fetched
items.synopsis: After accidentally releasing her own chaotic canine creature into the world, a young woman named Rue joins a rock band of late-2000's misfits to fight for survival in a town where science is at odds with the horrific supernatural.

items.title: Shattered Legends
items.synopsis: A six-part hololive production x Critical Role Daggerheart mini-series set in Exandria's Shattered Teeth, led by Matthew Mercer.

items.title: Student of the Year: After Dark
items.original_title: Student of the Year: After Dark

items.title: Agent Zeta
items.synopsis: Four Spanish ex-intelligence officers are assassinated simultaneously worldwide. The CNI discovers all participated in the covert "Operation Ciénaga" decades ago in Colombia. Zeta, the CNI's best operative, must hunt and protect the sole survivor, facing his deadliest global mission yet. Top Colombian agent Alfa will join Zeta, seemingly knowing more about "Ciénaga"'s secrets than him.

items.title: Murder in Galicia
items.synopsis: In Pazos, Irene is brutally attacked, and Civil Guard sergeant Elías suspects her husband Aniceto, racing against time to uncover the truth before it’s too late.

items.title: The Awakened
items.synopsis: A man awakens from suspended animation with memories of 1955 and reunites with his grandson, while a boxer begins recovering mysterious memories connected to secrets beneath the sea.

items.title: Ashland
items.synopsis: Shot on S16mm over the course of 8 years, ASHLAND examines the hopes and dreams of young people, horse whisperers, Indigenous elders, and mystics, all living today in the sacred lands of Eastern Montana.

items.title: Sword & Silence
items.synopsis: Six centuries of war have left the Three Kingdoms in turmoil. Facing powerful rivals, a small nation fights to unite a divided land.

items.title: Honey
items.synopsis: East Berlin, 1982. Marta, 24, is a deep cover agent for MI6. Surrounded by enemies and constantly under threat of her cover being blown, she tries her hardest to avoid detection by Friedrich Bauman, the new Head of Counter Espionage for the Stasi. Finding herself caught between Friedrich and the reckless, arrogant (and incredibly attractive…) CIA operative Aaron Neeland, she is blind-sided by desire in this Cold War menage-a-trois.

items.title: Burrito and Marshy
items.synopsis: Burrito and Marshy are a couple thirty-something other worldly people living in Padioho, New York City.

items.title: Newborn
items.synopsis:
Set in the Bronx in 1979, NEWBORN follows the Nine Pack, a group of young outsiders forced to go on the run after burning money and drugs belonging to the dangerous Skulls gang.

With their lives on the line, everything changes when one of them unexpectedly returns with a newborn baby, turning their fight for survival into a story of loyalty, sacrifice, and the meaning of family.

items.title: Kidney
items.synopsis: In a remote village, two rival families – one privileged Hindu, the other a struggling Muslim family – are trapped in an endless cycle of feuds. A young man dreaming of TikTok fame and a woman yearning to escape patriarchy fall in love. When an inheritance dispute erupts, their relationship is caught between greed, betrayal, and a conflict that threatens to turn blood against blood.

items.title: Crime and Punishment in America
items.synopsis: Explores the history of criminal justice in America — from the pre-colonial period to 21st century mass incarceration.

items.title: Damian Ghostkeeper
items.synopsis: Set in the underworld city of “Hellywood,” Damian Ghostkeeper follows the misadventures of the title character, a wealthy and flamboyant demon child, and Gretchen, his cynical babysitter.

items.title: Honesty House
items.synopsis: A group of single men and women live together in a paradisiacal setting, but with one absolute, unbreakable rule: they must always tell the truth. The participants—including couples who have chosen to join the experiment—are subjected to periodic questioning while connected to a lie-detection system. The polygraph probes critical topics, such as their true intentions, physical attraction toward other contestants, and the most deeply hidden secrets of their lives.

items.title: The Countess of Monte Cristo
items.synopsis: 1815. When her fiancé is wrongfully imprisoned and her rescue attempt ends in tragedy, Mercédès vows revenge against those who destroyed her life.

items.title: Second Chance Holiday
items.synopsis: Dating expert Chelsey (Ayesha Curry) is determined to break her so-called “curse” of always getting dumped during the holiday season. But when fate reunites her with her high school flame (Matthew Daddario), she wonders if her bad luck might just be the universe’s way of leading her back to her first love.

items.title: KILL/SAVE
items.synopsis: In a locked-down megacity where reality is optional, a lonely programmer risks his mind to rescue his girlfriend from a virtual prison — only to face a truth that challenges the very meaning of salvation and free will.

items.title: The Circle
items.synopsis: This social experiment brings together everyday players and celebrities to compete side by side in a game of popularity where identity is ever-changing, and anyone can be anyone. Filmed in real time, the series gives viewers exclusive access as twists and player ratings unfold, with audience votes shaping the game. This fresh take supercharges the original's signature mix of strategy and deception into an addictive experience built for today's always-on audience.

items.title: He Said, She Said: Till Death Do Us Part
items.original_title: He Said, She Said: Till Death Do Us Part
items.synopsis: Follows a no-holds-barred custody battle between two high-powered lawyers, which extends beyond the courtroom into social media and the court of public opinion.

items.title: The Hunger Games: Sunrise on the Reaping
items.original_title: The Hunger Games: Sunrise on the Reaping
items.synopsis: Return to the world of Panem 24 years before the events of The Hunger Games, starting on the morning of the reaping of the 50th Hunger Games, also known as the Second Quarter Quell.

items.title: Guarding Stars
items.synopsis: When a no-nonsense bodyguard is assigned to protect a charming action star over the holidays, sparks fly, secrets unravel, and Christmas gets a whole lot more complicated.

items.title: Win the Mall
items.synopsis: Ten teams move into a mall where they must conquer storefronts, forge alliances and outsmart rivals to win $1 million in this reality competition series.

items.title: Small Town Trouble: Texas
items.synopsis: Set in Boerne, Texas, the series follows a charming yet unconventional group of mothers and social insiders and their husbands as conservative small-town values collide with forbidden attraction, messy friendships, and shocking secrets. Here, perception is everything, temptation is everywhere, and the truth is never as buttoned-up as it looks.

items.title: Sweet Homes
items.synopsis: What starts as an idea between friends quickly becomes their biggest gamble yet. Together, they set out to build a million-dollar dream home on Alabama's Smith Lake before summer's end, betting that years of friendship are enough to see them through.

items.title: V. Shantaram
items.synopsis: Chronicles Shantaram Rajaram Vankudre, aka V. Shantaram, on his remarkable journey from the silent era through the advent of sound and colour, showcasing his evolution as one of India’s most influential filmmakers.

items.title: Somos así
items.synopsis: An ensemble comedy about a group of friends in their thirties and forties whose lives are upended all at once: their jobs become unstable, their relationships shift, dates go awry, and certain secrets come to light. Amidst the chaos, they must decide what they want to hold onto from the lives they once led and what they are willing to change.

items.title: Vienna Game
items.synopsis: While Napoleon Bonaparte is exiled on Elba, kings and crown princes, ministers and spies, noblewomen and mistresses, adventurers, inventors, artists, and concubines gather in Vienna to celebrate and negotiate. Here, the fate of Europe is decided on the dance floor and in the boudoir.

items.title: Valentina and the 12 Signs
items.synopsis: Valentina is a young woman who, after being betrayed by her boyfriend—and blaming astrology for the end of their relationship—decides to take revenge in an unusual way: she sets out on a mission to hook up with a guy from every sign of the zodiac. Her plan is to document all these encounters and experiences in a videocast, but things get complicated when she falls for a guy who has "no sign."

items.title: Gordon
items.synopsis: In this series, based on the book by Marcelo Larraquy, the thief Aníbal Gordon transforms into a murderer during the violent Argentina of the 1970s.

items.title: Dark Noon
items.synopsis: Caught in a cycle of petty crime and imprisonment, a man is released from prison for a failed bank robbery attempt while an impending solar eclipse offers a way out of the cycle.

items.title: Josephine
items.synopsis: After eight-year-old Josephine accidentally witnesses a brutal assault, she begins acting out violently to protect herself. This emotional trauma leads to conflicts between her parents as they search for justice and a way to feel safe again.

items.title: The Altruists
items.synopsis: The story of Sam Bankman-Fried and Caroline Ellison, two hyper-smart, ambitious young idealists who tried to remake the global financial system in the blink of an eye - before they were accused of stealing $8 billion and became Gen Z's own Bonnie & Clyde.

items.title: Sh*t Happens
items.synopsis: When their nine-year-old daughter falls mysteriously ill, a wealthy Dominican couple turns to an experimental treatment created from their housemaid Liddy's feces, without her knowledge. Once Liddy and her colleague Dominga discover the truth, they seize the opportunity to turn the household’s power dynamics upside down.

items.title: Agnes & Amir
items.original_title: Lieblingsmenschen - Die außergewöhnliche Freundschaft von Agnes & Amir
items.synopsis: Amir is 28, gay and has just fled from Iran. Agnes is 101 and still too young for a retirement home - she thinks. The two move in together - and save each other's lives.

items.title: Steps
items.synopsis: Think you know Cinderella's 'evil' stepsisters? Think again! When misunderstood Lilith is blamed for hijacking the Royal Ball with a stolen magic wand, she accidentally turns her sister Margot into a frog and leaves the kingdom in the hands of a prince-obsessed mean girl. Now Lilith must team up with Cinderella — and a surprisingly dreamy troll — to save the kingdom, repair the fractured fairytale, and prove that even so-called villains deserve a shot at happily-ever-after.

items.title: Best Pancakes in the County
items.synopsis: Over the course of one explosive night, a small-town diner becomes the epicenter of a deadly standoff involving rogue federal agents, a fast-talking con man with a dangerous past, and a waitress harboring secrets of her own.

items.title: November 1963
items.synopsis: Follows the 48 hours after the assassination of President John F. Kennedy, the alleged involvement of Sam Giancana and the 'Chicago Outfit', and a supposed broken promise after the mob helped to get Kennedy elected.

items.title: Melania, the Series
items.synopsis: A two-part docuseries about US First Lady Melania Trump, a companion to her 2026 documentary film.

items.title: Pratap
items.synopsis: A decorated encounter specialist is imprisoned for murder, leading to a journey of self-discovery revealing that his arrest is retribution tied to his past.

items.title: Kaali Kheti
items.synopsis: Plot TBA; set against a rural backdrop and explores a world where family, legacy and buried truths come together to create an unsettling tale of fear.

items.title: Elsinore
items.synopsis: The deeply emotional and inspirational true story of Ian Charleson, a gifted actor whose greatest challenge becomes his greatest triumph. Facing his own mortality with unflinching honesty, wit, and grace, Charleson delivers a courageous performance that becomes a source of healing and inspiration for those around him.

items.title: The Blue Road
items.synopsis: Two detectives join forces when brutal murders and cryptic messages surface across borders — but the deadly truth lurks dangerously close.

items.title: Bill's Included
items.synopsis: Middle-aged divorcee Bill Beam staves off financial ruin by renting his spare rooms to students. Warm-hearted and eager but neurotic and slightly overbearing, Bill is thrilled by the youthful energy his lodgers bring – but baffled by their indifference to his laminated house rules and colour-coded cutlery. He's torn between wanting to be part of the gang - sharing banter, keeping up with trends - and clinging to his role as responsible adult.

items.title: Fight for My Way
items.synopsis: After years of fiercely protecting each other from the sidelines, Hanz and Aira realize that their biggest challenge isn't conquering their dead-end careers, but risking their friendship for a chance at love.

items.title: AndherPura Curse
items.synopsis: AndherPura Curse Is A Minecraft Series Presented By SmilyBag.

items.title: Supreme Solaris
items.synopsis:
Seventeen-year-old Veer Singh's life changes forever when an extraordinary alien device known as Xion bonds with his chest, awakening powers beyond human comprehension. As the ancient cosmic intelligence within Xion guides him through a dangerous journey of discovery and training, Veer must learn to control his newfound abilities and confront the responsibility that comes with them.

But becoming a hero demands more than extraordinary power. Faced with fear, difficult choices, and threats that extend far beyond Earth, Veer must discover what it truly means to become Supreme Solaris—the one who stands as a beacon of hope when darkness threatens humanity.

items.title: Dig
items.synopsis: Follow four women who work at an archeological dig in Greece. When the team uncovers a long-buried secret with the potential to rewrite history, they find themselves at the center of a high-stakes international conspiracy.

items.title: New Wave
items.synopsis: The fascinating story of New Wave music and the decade from 1977 to 1987 that brought alternative culture into the mainstream.

items.title: The Trials of Karen Read
items.synopsis: An accident, a deadly fight or an elaborate cover-up? This true-crime series digs into the murder trials of Karen Read that sparked viral conspiracies.

items.title: The Substitute
items.synopsis: A top high school student is blackmailed into taking a substitute college entrance exam, leading to a manipulation crime thriller.

items.title: Way of the Warrior Kid
items.synopsis: Jake is an injured Navy SEAL who becomes a mentor for his shy, struggling nephew Marc. Using the principles of his military training, Jake teaches Marc how to be a Warrior Kid as he enters high school.

items.title: The Hangover Cure
items.synopsis: A sudden power outage forces flatmates Arindam, a burdened corporate employee, and Manek, a struggling aspiring writer, away from their screens and into a deep conversation.

items.title: Hexed
items.synopsis: An impulsive and unconventional teenage girl named Billie discovers secret magical abilities which, once unleashed, hurtle her into a spectacle-filled journey out of suburbia and into a vast witch realm called Hexe. Forced to team up with her cautious mother, Alice, they uncover family mysteries that could change the world of witches forever.

items.title: THE FURTHER MIS-ADVENTURES OF CLIFF BOOTH
items.original_title: THE FURTHER MIS-ADVENTURES OF CLIFF BOOTH
items.synopsis: Eight years after the events of Once Upon a Time in... Hollywood, Cliff Booth returns to a changing Los Angeles. Now working as a fixer in the shadows of the Hollywood studio system, Cliff finds himself entangled in a dangerous web of secrets, crimes and betrayals that will test everything he knows about loyalty and survival.

items.title: Focker-in-Law
items.synopsis: Henry, son of Greg and Pam Focker, faces family chaos when he decides to marry a strong-willed woman who appears to be his complete mismatch.

items.title: Hershey
items.synopsis: Based on the life of Milton Hershey, founder of the iconic Hershey chocolate company.  Milton's grit and determination to conquer the world of candy-making propel him from bankruptcy to monumental success, and the love of his life, Kitty, helps him build a legacy sweeter than any candy bar. But when Kitty falls ill, Milton’s wild optimism teeters on the edge of destruction, and she sparks an even bolder dream: to leave their fortune in the hands of America’s children in need.

items.title: Blade Runner 2099
items.synopsis: Fifty years after the events of Blade Runner 2049, Los Angeles has been reborn, just not by humanity. Cora, a fugitive in a final bid to stop running, takes on one last identity: a Blade Runner. Forced to partner with Olwen, a Replicant days from dying, she hunts down a runaway hiding a truth that could collapse their fragile city.

items.title: Nine to Six
items.synopsis: A workaholic woman learns to balance love and career after meeting a warm-hearted man who transforms her life.

items.title: Fool Night
items.synopsis: In a dark world full of despair, he chooses the path of transforming into a Spirit Flower — a plant into which humans transform. Should he continue living as a person, or discard his pain and start a new life as a plant? Which path would you choose in his situation?

items.title: Paige Prater: Sparkles and Shadows
items.synopsis: Paige loves sparkles. And Stormy loves shadows. They make a pair of Sparkles and Shadows. When the girls sparkle and shade, it up to them to make a difference.

items.title: Toos: The Van der Valk Kidnapping
items.original_title: Toos: De van der valk ontvoering
items.synopsis:
Toos and her husband, Gerrit van der Valk, run the largest hotel empire in the Netherlands. But on November 26, 1982, disaster struck: Toos was kidnapped in what would become one of the most sensational cases in Dutch history.

While Gerrit and the children desperately searched, police officer Cor Mulder moved into Hotel Nuland to work undercover as "cousin Cor" to track down the kidnappers and keep the family afloat. The kidnapping gripped the entire country while Toos fought for her life in an undisclosed location. The media followed every detail, the government worried about the consequences of a possible ransom payment, and the perpetrators' demands became increasingly extreme. For twenty nerve-wracking days, Toos and her family fought for survival—and for each other.

items.title: Tangles
items.synopsis: A young woman is forced to return to the conservative small town where her bizarre family lives to take care of her mother, having to deal with the cruel reality of her mom's Alzheimer disease and become the daughter they need.

items.title: Munawwara Ka Khadim
items.synopsis: Munawwara Ka Khadim is an upcoming Pakistani television drama series on HUM TV that stars the popular on-screen reunion of Hamza Sohail and Sehar Khan.

items.title: Yeh Prem Mol Liya
items.synopsis: A heartfelt romantic family drama about two best friends whose close bond slowly turns into love. But one lie creates misunderstandings and conflicts, putting their relationship and family bonds to the test. The story explores love, sacrifice, understanding and the importance of family.

items.title: Gunmaaster G9
items.synopsis: A man in love takes extreme measures to be with the woman he desires, facing off against a dangerous adversary.

items.title: Diler
items.synopsis: A Maddock Film

items.title: The Hunchback: Soul of Paris
items.synopsis: As cholera threatens to ravage the city of Paris in 1830, a hunchback hunted for medical experiments is caught between political turmoil and impossible love.

items.title: The Boy Who Stole Billions?
items.synopsis: At 30, Sam Bankman-Fried ran a $32 billion crypto empire until he was convicted of stealing $8 billion in customer funds, one of the biggest frauds in U.S. history. For the first time, he tells his story from prison.

items.title: Trinity
items.synopsis: A heroic female naval officer becomes involved with the outwardly charismatic Secretary of Defense, only to discover that he may be at the heart of a dangerous conspiracy.

items.title: Never Have I Spent The Winter With The Romano Brothers
items.original_title: Never Have I Spent The Winter With The Romano Brothers
items.synopsis: Gigi, a big city girl, finally moves into a small town to attend Alaskan High. She intends on not letting anything distract her, especially not boys.

items.title: The Man with the Bag
items.synopsis: After Santa’s magic bag is stolen, he turns to his naughty list to find Vance, a thief, to help him get it back. Along with his daughter, Santa, and a group of misfits, Vance will have to pull off the greatest heist of his life to save Christmas.

items.title: Behemoth!
items.synopsis: Gifted cellist Alex Serian returns home to Los Angeles after 20 years on the road. Music, which has been the constant, all-consuming river of his life, begins to carry Alex on an adventure that will change him forever.

items.title: Violent Night 2
items.synopsis: When Santa forgets the true meaning of Christmas, he finds himself in the heart of a lively mall community in desperate need of his help. Sapped of his magic, he’ll need another way to take on the goons threatening the mall, and time is running out. Santa has to rediscover his faith in goodness and call in some last-minute reinforcements from the one person no baddie wants to tangle with: Mrs. Claus.

items.title: Ray Gunn
items.synopsis: In Metropia, a gigantic city in an alternate future as seen from 1939, private eye Raymond Gunn is drawn into a case involving aliens, murder and a multimedia star named Venus Nova.

items.title: Asterix: The Kingdom of Nubia
items.synopsis: The irreductible Gauls are turned into harmless children after a rare youth elixir accidentally ends up into the magic potion. To find the antidote and save the village from the Romans attack, Asterix and Obelix embark on a crazy journey to the far away Kingdom of Nubia.

items.title: 2 Aile Arasında
items.synopsis: Sequel to 'In the Family' (2017). Plot TBA.

items.title: Pride and Prejudice
items.synopsis: Elizabeth Bennet is an unmarried woman and the second of five daughters of Mr. and Mrs. Bennet from Hertfordshire, near London. The Bennet home can only be inherited by males in the family, so the pressure is on for the daughters to marry well or risk losing everything. While out in society, Elizabeth interacts with single men like Mr. Darcy, an outwardly curmudgeon who is misunderstood.

items.title: The Gallerist
items.synopsis: A desperate gallerist conspires to sell a dead body at Art Basel Miami.

items.title: Diary of a Wimpy Kid Christmas: The Getaway
items.original_title: Diary of a Wimpy Kid Christmas: The Getaway
items.synopsis: With the stress of the holidays fast approaching, the Heffley family – to Greg's dismay – makes a last-minute decision to escape to an all-inclusive island resort for some much-needed rest and relaxation. As hilarious hijinks ensue, the Heffleys soon discover that paradise may not be everything it's cracked up to be.

items.title: Bokshi
items.synopsis: Anahita, traumatised by the brutal disappearance of her mother, finds comfort in Shalini, her history teacher. On an unconventional school excursion to a mysterious prehistoric site, she confronts her terrifying destiny.

items.title: Eetha
items.synopsis: Vithabai Narayangaonkar, a renowned Marathi Tamasha and Lavani performer rises from humble beginnings to become one of Maharashtra's most celebrated folk theatre artists.

items.title: Maatrubhumi:  May War Rest in Peace
items.synopsis: Based on the events that took place between the Indian and Chinese troops at the Galwan region on June 15, 2020 when 200 Indian soldiers bravely defended their territory against a force of 1200 Chinese Liberation Army soldiers

items.title: Cousin Isha
items.synopsis: After being publicly humiliated and heartbroken when his lover marries someone else, Ajit, the son of a small-town sweet shop owner, hits rock bottom-until Isha, his bold and fashionable distant cousin, unexpectedly enters his life, turning his pain into a potential new beginning.

items.title: Last Stay at Hotel Safestay
items.synopsis: This world is not made for fairy-tale adventures. Viri, a 12-year-old, realises this as she embarks on a solo stroll during a vacation with her family.

items.title: Alice
items.synopsis: From Paris's Belle Époque to New-York and early Hollywood, follow the remarkable journey of a visionary artist who defied conventions and expectations as a filmmaker, entrepreneur, wife, and mother. Her loves, her battles, and her relentless pursuit of recognition unfold against the birth of modern cinema.

items.title: Sacred Jewel
items.synopsis: Set during the final years of the Mongol invasions of Korea, the story follows a group risking everything to recover and protect the sacred Avalokitesvara Jewel on a perilous mission across the Goryeo Dynasty. As war rages, Commander Baek-gyeol, Princess Wang-hee, and their companions must navigate love, sacrifice, and political turmoil in a fight for their nation's future.

items.title: Sunshine Girls
items.synopsis: Olivia’s parents’ separation plants her as the new girl at Valley High, where she meets horse girl Taylor and influencer Riley. Freshman year for the unlikely trio of best friends is full of family drama, false starts and first kisses as they each have their time in the sun.

items.title: Narayan Pustika 2 - Endless
items.synopsis: This movie is the second part of the Narayana Pustika trilogy. In which there is a description of the troubles arising from the opening of the unimaginable door revealed by the great sages.

items.title: Rewind Barcelona
items.synopsis: Hascoët, Émile, Léo, and Paul are a rowdy group of teenage skateboarders. They pile into Léo’s mom’s car and drive to Barcelona, the mecca of skateboarding, for their first trip away as almost-adults. They live on vacuum-sealed tortillas, drink warm cans of Lemon Damm, and spend their days and nights at MACBA. The beach might as well not exist, and the Sagrada Família is just something they pass on the way. All that matters is skating, drifting through the city, and burning through those first fragile days of freedom. Ten years later, they try to piece it back together over a few scattered phone calls. The memories are still there, but something has shifted. What once felt infinite now comes back in fragments.

items.title: The Debut
items.synopsis: When Mona Friedman is cast in a bit part at a small community theater, she transforms from a shy, unassuming housewife into a zealous method actor willing to do anything to protect the artistic integrity of her marginal role—even if it means waging war against the show’s domineering director.

items.title: The Murder of JonBenét Ramsey
items.synopsis: The series centers on one of the most infamous unsolved murder cases in American history, and the devastating personal and public reckoning that followed the death of JonBenet Ramsey on Christmas night in 1996.

items.title: Who the Hell Is Hamish?
items.synopsis: Inspired by an industrious fraudster, and the group of victims who eventually decided they had had enough of him, the charming and cultured Hamish sets his sights on Bec, a recently divorced single mother with three sons and access to a significant family trust. When Bec notices gaps in his story and some odd behaviour, what starts as private unease widens into something far larger: a pattern of deception spanning continents and suspected of leaving more than $70 million in its wake.

items.title: Talk Money
items.synopsis: FINALLY, the raw, transparent conversations you wish you heard about money growing up. Find out what happens before the Grammys, Emmy, awards, elevation, recognition and success. Tune in to see how these exceptional guests transformed their passion into profit.

items.title: Matar a un oso
items.synopsis: The death of the bear Cachou in the Aran Valley has triggered a criminal investigation—an inquiry of a scale unprecedented in the context of an animal’s death. The suspects are the valley’s own inhabitants, and the valley itself serves as the stage where two worlds collide—the global and the ancestral—and where people of integrity go to great lengths to prevent the mountains from going up in flames.

items.title: Bad Day
items.synopsis: On one of the worst and wildest days of her life, single mom Joy fights to keep one little promise to her daughter.

items.title: Ink
items.synopsis: A group of misfits and visionaries had an idea for a new kind of news - one that would give the people what they want, and would change the face of the world we live in today.

items.title: Zero A.D.: The Birth of Christ
items.original_title: Zero A.D.: The Birth of Christ
items.synopsis: A star rises over Bethlehem as Christ is born. But when Herod orders the slaughter of the innocents, Mary and Joseph must protect the child promised to save the world.

items.title: Tantara
items.synopsis: In years of crackdowns and fear, Korea's show world kept the lights on and the dream alive — fighting for a stage where grit could turn to glory.

items.title: Dune: Part Three
items.synopsis: Nearly two decades after he seized control of the Imperium, Paul Atreides is now a ruthless Emperor, and must face the consequences of his reign as old allies return, terrifying new threats emerge, and betrayal lurks in every shadow. Haunted by visions of Imperial collapse and the reappearance of his long-lost love, Paul is drawn into a sweeping conspiracy, with Chani at the heart of its unfolding mystery. As enemies close in, Paul must confront the true cost of power and the fate of those he loves the most.

items.title: Batman: Knightfall Part 2: Knightquest
items.synopsis: Batman lies broken at the hands of the villainous mastermind Bane. With Bruce Wayne paralyzed from the waist down and unable to continue as Batman, a new successor must be chosen to defend Gotham City. Jean-Paul Valley, the man also known as Azrael, must take up the mantle of the Batman. But will his more violent methods be enough to stop Bane?

items.title: Avengers: Doomsday
items.synopsis: Beloved heroes from three distinct universes are set on a deadly collision course and face an existential threat unlike anything they've ever encountered.

items.title: TED: The Animated Series
items.synopsis: Picking up twelve years after the conclusion of the last movie, John and his thunder-buddy Ted are neighbors, both with families of their own and dead-end jobs. Follow these two lovable stoners as they enable each other's bad ideas about marriage, parenting and the challenges of adult life.

items.title: Unaccustomed Earth
items.synopsis: When a health crisis forces a devoted mother and her family to return to the US, she confronts buried desires that upend her Indian American community.

items.title: Quiztopia
items.synopsis: In an alternate Japan, a charismatic host runs a deadly quiz where winners get any wish and losers pay dearly. His world unravels when rebels target him.

items.title: Frisco King
items.synopsis: New Orleans gangster Russell Lee Washington Jr. lands in Frisco, Texas, where he transforms small hustles into big business, with the help of an ambitious protégé, a loyal driver, and a growing network of eccentric partners.

items.title: The Eyes
items.synopsis: Flower Forever

items.title: The Angry Birds Movie 3
items.synopsis: Red faces his greatest challenge yet—surviving fatherhood… while saving the world.

items.title: Jumanji: Open World
items.synopsis: Our heroes have escaped the ever-changing jungles of Jumanji before, but this time the game comes to us—as Jumanji breaks free of its console, unleashing its chaos into our world.

items.title: Kumaari
items.synopsis: An upcoming thriller.

items.title: King
items.synopsis: Mentor and disciple embark on a perilous journey, pushing their survival skills to the limit against overwhelming odds and unforgiving environments.

items.title: The Alfred Eulogy
items.synopsis: Following the death of his friend Alfred, Ryan prepares to deliver a eulogy. What begins as an attempt to remember the dead gradually becomes a deeply personal confrontation with grief, guilt, resentment, loneliness, and everything left unsaid between two people.  As Ryan’s memories begin to fracture and contradict one another, the distinction between remembrance and reality slowly dissolves. The Alfred Eulogy is an intimate exploration of grief, masculinity, emotional repression, and the weight of words that were never spoken.

items.title: Philosophy of the Porch
items.synopsis: A dedicated young woman serving as her family's primary financial provider finds her matrimonial aspirations permanently derailed when she uncovers a debilitating secret: their ancestral home was pawned by her late father to finance her eldest brother's opulent wedding.

items.title: Werwulf
items.synopsis: A harrowing tale of devotion, damnation and the devil within.

items.title: Artificial
items.synopsis: In November 2023, amidst the height of a global AI boom, OpenAI co-founder Ilya Sutskever teamed with the company board to make one of the defining decisions that has drastically reshaped the company as we know it, the firing of current CEO Sam Altman. This controversial decision would lead to immense backlash, ultimately resulting in Altman's return five days later.

items.title: Mr. Irrelevant
items.synopsis: The last player selected in the 1983 NFL draft by the New York Giants, underdog John Tuggle, defies expectations on and off the field for head coach Bill Parcells, his newfound love, and his team, proving that remarkable hope and perseverance can transcend even the greatest challenges.

items.title: The Poolrooms
items.synopsis: A teenager trapped inside a seemingly endless aquatic labyrinth of swimming pools, towering waterslides, flooded corridors, and impossible architecture. As he ventures deeper into the surreal liminal maze and reality itself begins to unravel, a mysterious creature stalks him from beneath the water, forcing him to find a way out before he disappears forever.

items.title: Harry Potter
items.synopsis: There is nothing special about Harry Potter - at least that's what his Aunt Petunia always says. On his 11th birthday, a letter of admittance to Hogwarts School of Witchcraft and Wizardry opens up a hidden world for Harry: one of fun, friendship and magic. But with this new adventure comes great risk as Harry is forced to face a dangerous enemy from his past.

items.title: Clara and the Below
items.synopsis: To save her bedridden ex-military father, Clara must fight the spirits of the soldiers he killed on the battlefield in a surreal world known simply as the Below. She is aided by a mischievous toy nutcracker, her only guide in a place where the ghosts of the past run rampant.

items.title: Chiranjeevi Hanuman: The Eternal
items.synopsis: An AI-generated film about the Hindu god Hanuman; it will draw from the sacred texts of Indian epic 'Ramayana' and Puranic literature to create what producers describe as an “awe-inspiring, visual odyssey designed to be enjoyed as a shared experience in theaters.”

items.title: Teen Kauwe
items.synopsis: An Out and Out Comedy

items.title: Call the Midwife: Sisters in Arms
items.original_title: Call the Midwife: Sisters in Arms
items.synopsis: In September 1939, Nonnatus House is the beating heart of the East End community of Poplar. The nurses and nuns dedicate their lives to mothers, babies and the poor. But there is no gas and air, no penicillin, no cure for TB, and no welfare state. Then war is declared — and life gets even harder. While bombs rain from the sky, women give birth underground, families are shattered and whole streets are reduced to ruins. But courage and resilience triumphs as the community unites to survive.

items.title: Fixer Upper: Chip Bought a Mansion
items.original_title: Fixer Upper: Chip Bought a Mansion
items.synopsis: Renovating a massive estate, which Joanna describes as a setting straight out of Beauty and the Beast.

items.title: My Little Pony: Forever Friendship
items.synopsis: The series is said to follow “Twilight Sparkle, Pinkie Pie, Rainbow Dash, and Fluttershy as they embark on a new journey of friendship, magic and self-discovery.”

items.title: Legends
items.synopsis: Follows the cast of "Sons of Anarchy" as they reunite at a fan convention after more than a decade, where the line between life and art blurs and the fractured brotherhood faces a real-world threat.

items.title: Lumine
items.synopsis: Follows Lumine, a down-on-his-luck weredog who meets antisocial witch boy Kody and stumbles into a family full of secrets in a world where weredogs, witches, and humans coexist.

items.title: Esref Tek
items.synopsis: Set before the events of Eşref Rüya, Eşref Tek follows Eşref’s early years in the criminal underworld and his alliance with Kadir. The series explores the past, choices, and relationships that shaped Eşref into the man he would become.

items.title: The Twin
items.synopsis: Suffocating in a loveless marriage to Adam, Nicola’s life takes a dramatic turn when Adam’s long-estranged identical twin brother Lee comes crashing back into her life, and their tangled romantic past threatens to destroy the present. A split-second decision and a terrible accident drives Nicola to protect her children, and over the course of one week, Lee and Nicola are forced together, struggling to maintain a web of secrets and lies. Though they can’t ignore their feelings for each other, they both know they’re living on borrowed time.

items.title: The Rockford Files
items.synopsis: Newly paroled after doing time for a crime he didn’t commit, James Rockford returns to his life as a private investigator using his charm and wit to solve cases around Los Angeles. It doesn't take long for his quest for legitimacy to land him squarely in the crosshairs of both local police and organized crime.

items.title: Mouthwashing : The Film
items.synopsis: The Indian Film Adaptation Of The Bone-Chilling Video Game - Mouthwashing

items.title: The Ambassador
items.synopsis: Olivia Winters, a former actor turned savvy-yet-unorthodox diplomat, and her childhood best friend Andrea Taylor, a sharp, policy-driven Chargé d’Affaires, are sent to the hinterland of global diplomacy to uncover new business opportunities for Canada in a rapidly shifting world. Tasked with doing more with less, and operating far from the polished centers of power, Olivia and Andrea rely on bold instincts, chaotic brilliance, and uniquely Canadian workarounds to punch far above their weight. Under constant scrutiny from Ottawa, the duo turns diplomatic afterthoughts into surprising wins, even while skating on very thin ice.

items.title: Baywatch
items.synopsis: Following in the footsteps of his legendary father, Hobie Buchannon serves as a Baywatch Captain, leading new generation of lifeguards to the Southern California coast, where high-stakes rescues collide with attraction, friendship, family and responsibility. But Hobie's world is turned upside down when his daughter Charlie Vale shows up on his doorstep eager to carry on the Buchannon family legacy.

items.title: The Rookie: North
items.synopsis: After a violent home invasion ignites a dormant purpose, Alex Holland battles a lifetime of failed commitments by joining the Pierce County Police Department as a rookie. Policing from the urban coast to the rural forest where backup isn't just five minutes away, Alex must prove to his skeptical training officer, his fellow rookies and himself that he's finally found something worthy of the fight.

items.title: The Wanted Man
items.synopsis: For 20 years, Felix Carmichael has been the untouchable leader of Britain's most feared criminal empire. But when a betrayal within his ranks leads to incarceration, Felix will risk everything to exact revenge and reclaim his throne.

items.title: New State of Mind
items.synopsis: New State of Mind follows seven first-year students navigating college life, growth, and relationships at the fictional HBCU Oakley University.

items.title: Golmaal 5
items.synopsis: Get ready for another rollercoaster of laughter with the iconic gang.

items.title: Bosch: Start of Watch
items.synopsis: Follow 26-year-old Harry Bosch during his earliest days as a rookie cop in 1991 Los Angeles, a city on the edge, teeming with racial tension, gang violence, and a fractured LAPD. Amid routine calls and growing unrest, Bosch finds himself drawn into a high-profile heist and a web of criminal corruption that will test his loyalty to the badge and shape his future as the detective who lives by the code, "Everybody counts or nobody counts."

items.title: The Beekeeper 2
items.synopsis: Pulled back into the fight when the Beekeeper organization goes rogue and sets its sights on controlling the government, Clay must take on the very group that made him.

items.title: Lords of War
items.synopsis: Yuri Orlov, the world's most famous arms dealer, discovers that he has a son, Anton who is trying to outdo his father by raising an army of mercenaries to fight in America's Middle Eastern conflicts, triggering a father-son rivalry.

items.title: Criminal
items.synopsis: Follow the story of two friends, Leo Patterson and Ricky Lawless, one trying to fight his way out of the world of crime they were raised in, the other desperate to follow in the footsteps of his father, a legendary outlaw. And when Ricky's older brother Tracy returns home from the Army, their tragic family history comes home with him. Drawn into their orbit are Greta, a sharp-tongued car thief from Leo's past, and Mallory, Ricky's girlfriend, who fears what he'll do to get by. Gunfights, heists, and tragic romance are the order of the day, but will anyone make it out alive?

items.title: Fallout Shelter: The Experiment
items.synopsis: Inside Vault-Tec's bomb-proof vaults,  group of contestants take part in escalating challenges, strategic dilemmas, and moral crossroads"as they chase a cash prize.

items.title: River
items.synopsis: After the death of their father, three siblings take a boat trip to spread their dad's ashes. However, they discover they have inadvertently stumbled onto the hunting grounds of a strange pair of masked killers, and must fight for their lives on a busted motorboat.

items.title: Children of Blood and Bone
items.synopsis: In the world of Orïsha, a young woman goes on a quest to reclaim the magic that was violently stolen from her people. She and her brother ally with the daughter and son of the king to fight back against his brutal rule.

items.title: Untitled Feature Film
items.synopsis: On Thanksgiving Day 2016, the Nichols family's holiday gathering spirals into chaos when Becca, the family's estranged black sheep, arrives unannounced.

items.title: Bloodaxe
items.synopsis: Follow Erik Bloodaxe, and his formidable wife, Gunnhild, Mother of Kings as they fight for the throne of Norway, the land is torn apart by fierce rivals, shifting loyalties, and bloody betrayals. With war looming and chaos consuming the kingdom, drawing in the ruthless Kings of other Scandinavian countries, and even a powerful English ruler, the stage is set for a thundering, cataclysmic, compelling and utterly magical new Viking Saga.

items.title: Neuromancer
items.synopsis: A disgraced superhacker and a razorgirl assassin are recruited for a high-stakes heist targeting a powerful corporate dynasty with untold wealth...and secrets they'd kill to protect.

items.title: Love & War
items.synopsis: Two strong-willed Army officers find their lives intertwined with a woman, forming a complicated love triangle.

items.title: Winnie-the-Pooh: Blood and Honey - The Lost Years
items.original_title: Winnie-the-Pooh: Blood and Honey - The Lost Years
items.synopsis: Fifteen years after Pooh, Tigger, and Rabbit are captured and turned into attractions for the sinister Woozles Circus, orphaned teenager Momo Milne begins searching for her missing mother. Following a clue linking her mother’s disappearance to the circus, Momo and her best friend Billie take jobs inside the bizarre traveling show to uncover the truth.  Behind the bright lights and carnival magic, they discover a nightmare: the circus hides monstrous half-human creatures, violent secrets, and a trail of missing victims. As Pooh and the others struggle under cruel captivity, their bloodthirsty instincts begin to resurface, turning the carnival into a slaughterhouse.  Trapped inside a deadly world of twisted fairy tales and brutal horrors, Momo must unravel the connection between her mother and the circus before she and Billie become the next victims of the Woozles’ terrifying show.

items.title: Mate's Rate
items.synopsis: After getting fired, Uji, a graphic designer, teams up with her three closest friends to start a creative agency. Amid client demands, family expectations, and friendship dilemmas, she hopes this could be a new beginning. But deeper she goes, the more she realizes: every relationship has its price, friendship included.

items.title: Animal Friends
items.synopsis: Two fugitive animals embark on an adventure across America to find the ranch that was once their home, healing their friendship while pursued by an equally "odd-couple" DEA agent and Fish and Wildlife ranger with something to prove.

items.title: Lice
items.synopsis: A parasitic outbreak hits a Long Island high school in the 1980s, leading to military quarantine. Students infected with an unbearable itch fight each other for survival.

items.title: Le Teckel
items.synopsis: Guy Farkas, nicknamed "Le Teckel" (The Dachshund), a seasoned medical representative who has seen it all, will have to team up with a new young executive to sell a new medical drug suspected of having caused hundreds of deaths..

items.title: Ice Age: Boiling Point
items.synopsis: A dinosaur-and-lava-filled madcap adventure takes Manny, Sid, Diego, Ellie, Buck, acorn-obsessed Scrat – this time joined by Baby Scrat and the enormous Jurassic Scrat – and the rest of the herd to visit never before-seen corners of the treacherous Lost World.

items.title: Karōshi
items.synopsis: In a near-future Manhattan corporate loyalty and cultural tradition have reshaped everyday life. When a mysterious outsider infiltrates a powerful company after a worker's death, he exposes the violent system hidden beneath its polished surface.

items.title: Slayground
items.synopsis: Scare-actor "Metal Mike" Graves wakes up in a haunted attraction surrounded by the dead bodies of his co-workers with no memory of how they got there. As a state-wide manhunt closes in, he races to uncover the truth — even if the trail leads straight back to himself.

items.title: Reverse Myself
items.synopsis: A man who drowns in a pond and becomes trapped in another dimension attempts to recover a device stolen by his evil vibrance and restore his erased memories—driven by a single goal: to find his way back home.

items.title: Remain
items.synopsis: When reclusive architect Tate Gordon moves to small coastal town to complete his latest project, he encounters an alluring young woman who pulls him out of his shell, and into the center of a deadly mystery that hangs over the town.

items.title: LEGO Ninjago: Dragons' Fury
items.synopsis: Reeling from the loss of Lloyd, the Ninja face their evil counterparts. When signs of his survival offer new hope, the team embarks on a dangerous search for answers. Meanwhile, Ras gathers ancient artifacts for a plan that threatens the Merged Lands, forcing the Ninja to confront their grief, trust new leaders, and uncover secrets that could change their world forever.

items.title: Mr. Uncle Gary's Kitchen
items.synopsis: Mr. Uncle Gary’s Kitchen stars Gary Anthony Williams cooking up plant-based Southern comfort with humor and heart. Joined by guests, he shares stories, laughs, and vegan twists on classics in a warm, playful kitchen.

items.title: Silaa
items.synopsis: Plot TBA; centres on the intense relationship between Virat and Silaa that takes a tragic and violent turn.

items.title: Narnia: The Magician's Nephew
items.synopsis: Two children discover a wood full of pools leading to other worlds. One takes them to a dead city beneath a dying sun, where they wake a queen who exterminated its population and accidentally bring her back to London.

items.title: Barbershop
items.synopsis: Travis 'Trav' Porter endeavors to follow in the footsteps of his grandfather, a legendary barber at the Calvin's barbershop in Chicago. And while the barbers are new, the shop remains just as lively, the customers just as argumentative, and the fades are still the dopest in the city.

items.title: Prodigies
items.synopsis: Didi and Ren have been together since they were nine-year-old geniuses. Now in their early thirties and engaged to be married, they begin to wonder if they've settled for a life—and love—that's less than extraordinary.

items.title: Naagzilla
items.synopsis: In a world where shape-shifting Ichhadhaari naags have been living amongst humans, chaos ensues when a once carefree Ichhadhaari naag's Naagmani and his life are threatened by a wily, power- hungry villain.

items.title: The Land
items.synopsis: The story of two families, in which the high-stakes drama plays out not only on the field but also in the front offices of this NFL franchise, as a loyal fanbase wants a winning season now ... or face big changes if they don't.

items.title: Oswald
items.synopsis: When an earthquake releases Walt Disney's creation, Oswald, who has been hidden away since the 1920s, a middle school boy and his friends try to help the cartoon rabbit navigate his way through the modern world.

items.title: Gatto
items.synopsis: After years of maneuvering the canal-ridden, superstitious city of Venice, Italy, a scrappy black cat named Nero begins to question whether he’s lived the right lives. Indebted to Rocco, a ruthless local feline mob boss, Nero finds himself in a quandary and is forced to forge a truly unexpected friendship that may finally lead him to his purpose — unless Venice gets the better of him first.

items.title: The Thomas Crown Affair
items.synopsis: A debonair, adventuresome man believes he has pulled off the perfect multi-million dollar heist, only to match wits with an insurance investigator who will do anything to get her man.
